candidate_workaround: Pass encoding='utf-8' to every Python text read used for phase counts or validation and keep the failed locale-default probe as a negative witness.
failure_signature: A read-only Python count probe omitted an explicit encoding and the Windows locale decoder rejected a UTF-8 phase document.
recurrence_guard: Use explicit UTF-8 for every repository text read and set PYTHONUTF8 for bounded validation subprocesses.
rollback: Do not report file, JSON, or word counts from a probe that fails decoding.
scope_boundary: Read-only phase counting and validation only; no scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
